name: superagnt
description: superagnt is a marketing plugin for Claude and ChatGPT that helps businesses find customers through outbound, SEO and ads. This base plugin carries the skills for its MCP server: live data from X, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Reddit, LinkedIn and the web, people and company data, a real workspace Postgres, schedules, webhooks and shareable dashboards. On Claude, add the server as a connector at https://mcp.superagnt.com/mcp. Sign-in happens in your browser; the consent screen doubles as signup.
